verdict.rationale: dLocal documents a Sandbox environment with its own credentials. In it you can safely simulate payments, check API behavior and trigger webhooks without processing real transactions, and you can control payment outcomes via status codes in the `description` field. Sandbox and production are managed from the same account. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the sandbox, explicit documentation of separate sandbox endpoints and data isolation, and evidence that the MCP server or other agent tooling can target sandbox.
